### Correctness

```typescript
const amount = parseInt(price); // price is a decimal currency string
```

### Regression Example

When the `price` string contains a decimal point (e.g., `1.99`), the `parseInt()` method will truncate the decimal part, resulting in an incorrect `amount`:

```typescript
const price = '1.99';
const amount = parseInt(price); // amount will be 1 instead of 1.99
```
